settings.languageHint: Applies to labels, dates and number formatting.
settings.currencyIntro: The currency consolidated totals are reported in. Each property and account keeps its own currency; this only decides the unit the portfolio and balance rollups add up to.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save that. Please try again.
settings.alwaysConvertHint: Off by default: totals stay in their own currency while everything shares one, so no exchange rate is needed. Turn this on to see every total in {currency} — which means a rate is required for each other currency you hold.
settings.noRatesHint: Add one above and portfolios spanning currencies will start reporting totals.
settings.rateTooSmall: Enter a rate greater than zero.
settings.rateSaveFailed: Could not save that rate. Please try again.
settings.rateRemoveFailed: Could not remove that rate. Please try again.
settings.sameCurrency: A currency is always worth one of itself; pick two different currencies.
settings.ratesIntroManual: Rates you enter yourself — nothing is fetched, so a converted total is only ever as good as what is on this list, and every one is shown with the date you recorded it. Entering one direction is enough; the other is read off the same row.
settings.ratesIntroAutomatic: For pairs you have not entered yourself, the European Central Bank's daily reference rates are fetched and shown with the date they were published. A rate you enter always wins and is never overwritten. Entering one direction is enough; the other is read off the same row.
settings.noRatesHintAutomatic: Rates are fetched the first time a total spans currencies. You can also enter your own above — yours always wins.
settings.ratesProvider: Reference rates are published by the European Central Bank once each working day, at around 16:00 CET. They are not tradeable rates — your bank's rate will differ.
settings.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the rates just now. The rates already on record still apply.
